name: com.qudmi.fullbody
description:
Full-body avatar motion from a VR headset and two hand controllers, running on-device in real time. Add one component to a Humanoid-rigged avatar -- no ML code, no extra trackers, no per-joint wiring.

NOTE: the bundled model weights are trained on AMASS and are licensed for non-commercial research use only. The package code is MIT.
